The DTM was generated using the Ames Stereo Pipeline software (https://github.com/NeoGeographyToolkit/StereoPipeline)and using automated methods. The isis_provenance and asp_provenance metadata files provide reproducible workflows for the generation of these DTM products. Input data were first relatively aligned and photogrammetrically controlled at the Mars quad level. Next, community sensor model (CSM) Image Support Data (ISDs) were created to support processing using the CSM in ASP. Low resolution, 100mpp DTMs were then generated for each stereopair and used to seed the generation of a high resolution DTM. This high resolution DTM was aligned to MOLA using a two step pc_align process. Fro the aligned point cloud the final DEM was extracted at the described post spacing and a final adjustment made to align with the Mars aeroid (geoid).
